scope: A-side mechanical field supplement only; no new physical claim is introduced.
forbidden_claims: Do not claim graph residual power has been verified.
Do not claim same-sample material validation has been completed.
Do not use Srivastava Table II rows as evidence that graph metrics win.
Do not treat synthetic or blocked rows as physical validation.

deepening_1_layer_1.label: OI baseline absorption risk
deepening_1_layer_1.content: A-side conclusion remains baseline-first: Srivastava-style normalized orbital overlap, onsite variance, carrier density, mobility-edge margin, batch, pair density and finite-size controls can absorb graph quantities that are monotone reparameterizations of overlap, distance thresholding, coordination, weighted degree, or pair density.

deepening_1_layer_2.label: same-sample residual protocol
deepening_1_layer_2.content: Graph quantities are admissible only as residual predictors after a same-sample model y_s = f_y(OI_norm_s, onsite_variance_s, carrier_density_s, mobility_edge_margin_s, batch_s, finite_size_s) has produced external residuals r_y_s. Candidate graph terms are lambda2_resid_s, spectral_radius_resid_s and attack_resid_s only after overlap/degree/weight/size-preserving residualization.
deepening_1_layer_2.acceptance_condition: held-out residual improvement with stable signs and exact same-sample provenance after OI_norm plus controls

deepening_2_layer_1.label: forbidden controls and leakage boundary
deepening_2_layer_1.content: A-side forbidden-control rules block target-as-feature leakage, same-measurement algebraic transforms, Wannier/OI self-target leakage, graph construction metadata leakage, raw baseline-prediction leakage, and graph-independent claims before OI plus null residualization. The rules are declarative safeguards and do not by themselves establish a positive graph-physics claim.
current_warning_from_inspector: Residual placeholder cells in baseline rows should be normalized to empty or explicit NA before downstream parsing.
The multi-namespace oi;graph rule needs parser support or split rows for unambiguous execution.

deepening_2_layer_2.label: fixed-pair/fixed-density OI rule and blocked validation
deepening_2_layer_2.content: At fixed declared N_pair and pair-set class, use OI_pair_mean = OI_raw_sum / N_pair and do not interpret OI_raw_sum as a density effect. When N_pair changes with volume, composition or cutoff, use OI_norm = sum(N_ab*S_ab) / volume and include pair_density as a control or matching variable before testing graph metrics. If neither condition is satisfied, graph metrics may be diagnostics only.

fixed_density_fixed_pair_OI_rule.fixed_pair_rule: If compared samples have the same declared N_pair and pair-set class, use OI_pair_mean = OI_raw_sum / N_pair.
fixed_density_fixed_pair_OI_rule.fixed_density_rule: If N_pair changes with volume, composition or cutoff, use OI_norm = sum(N_ab*S_ab) / volume and include pair_density as a control or matching variable.
fixed_density_fixed_pair_OI_rule.failure_action: If neither fixed-pair nor fixed-density condition is satisfied, graph metrics may be computed as diagnostics but cannot support an independent residual-power claim.

formula.OI_norm: sum(N_ab*S_ab)/V for reported Srivastava Table II baseline rows
formula.OI_pair_mean: OI_raw_sum/N_pair under fixed declared N_pair and pair-set class

direction: At fixed pair sum, increasing volume lowers volume-normalized OI_norm.
At fixed N_pair, OI_pair_mean is the proper raw-sum normalization.
Graph metrics are admissible only after OI plus mandatory controls and null residualization.
